summary_text: Q1 2026 reported May 5, 2026. EBITDA $473M, Revenue $1.13B (beat). Catalysts: (1) Cornerstone Acquisition pending close — expected material FCF/share uplift 2027-2028; (2) data-center buildout (Susquehanna) continuing, data halls being filled/electrified, no slowdown; (3) capital structure optimized via opportunistic refinancing; (4) PJM 2027/2028 Base Residual Auction cleared 8,745 MW at $333.44/MW-day (~$1,067M capacity revenues). Next earnings (Q2 2026) typical August timing.
